panels.title: Treasury
panels.description: Latest credit balance on the newest transaction for the current era's player. Moves on every operation, not just trading.

panels.title: Trade Net (realised)
panels.description: Cargo sales minus cargo purchases for operation_type='tour' in the window. Realised only: cargo still in a hold has been paid for but not yet sold, so this understates mid-run. See 'Capital in Cargo' beside it.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS "trade net"
  FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
 WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
       AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
       AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
   AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at);

panels.title: Trade Revenue
panels.description: Gross credits received from SELL_CARGO on tour operations in the window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'SELL_CARGO'), 0) AS "revenue"
  FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
 WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
       AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
       AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
   AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at);

panels.title: Trade Spend
panels.description: Gross credits paid for PURCHASE_CARGO on tour operations in the window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO'), 0) AS "spend"
  FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
 WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
       AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
       AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
   AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at);

panels.title: Gross Margin
panels.description: Realised trade net as a percentage of cargo spend in the window. Shows the empty-state string rather than dividing by zero when nothing was bought.

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players),
-- MOVING WEIGHTED-AVERAGE COST (sp-7kfof).  Walks every cargo event for each
-- (hull, good) in chronological order: a purchase adds its spend and units and so
-- re-averages the holding, a sale releases units at the THEN-CURRENT average.  The
-- value left standing at any instant is therefore what was actually paid for the
-- units still held.
--
-- IT REPLACES A LIFETIME AVERAGE, which is the defect this fixes.  The previous
-- valuation multiplied net units held by total spend / total units over ALL history
-- - two different populations.  The units held come from specific recent lots; the
-- average came from every lot ever bought.  On TORWIND-2F5 that valued 60 EQUIPMENT
-- bought at 1,983/u at 2,633.9/u and 105 URANITE bought at 3,394/u at 3,277.5/u; the
-- errors did not cancel, closing came out 641,517 against 602,850 actually paid, and
-- the 38,667 gap ate the COGS denominator until the row read 1212.7% on a 31.7% run.
--
-- sp-d767k IS HONOURED AND STRENGTHENED.  That rule says held cargo is per-(hull,
-- good) NET units - bought minus sold - and must NEVER be derived from a last-sell
-- timestamp, because hulls interleave lots and a hull that sold an OLDER lot after
-- buying a NEWER one had its whole inventory erased.  Walking every event in order
-- is strictly stronger than the net-units subtraction it replaces: it cannot be
-- fooled by interleaving because it never looks at an aggregate at all.
ev AS (
  SELECT t.metadata->>'ship_symbol' AS hull, t.metadata->>'good_symbol' AS good,
         t.created_at, (t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO') AS is_buy,
         (t.metadata->>'units')::numeric AS units, (-t.amount)::numeric AS spend,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.metadata->>'ship_symbol', t.metadata->>'good_symbol'
                            ORDER BY t.created_at, t.id) AS rn
    FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
   WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
     AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
     AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
     AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'good_symbol','') <> ''
     AND t.created_at <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
walk AS (
  SELECT hull, good, rn, created_at,
         CASE WHEN is_buy THEN units ELSE 0 END AS units,
         CASE WHEN is_buy THEN spend ELSE 0 END AS value
    FROM ev WHERE rn = 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.hull, e.good, e.rn, e.created_at,
         CASE WHEN e.is_buy THEN w.units + e.units ELSE GREATEST(w.units - e.units, 0) END,
         -- A sale releases units at the running average.  Clamped at zero so a sale
         -- of cargo this ledger never saw bought (or a partial history) can only ever
         -- empty the holding, never drive its value negative into the COGS below.
         CASE WHEN e.is_buy THEN w.value + e.spend
              WHEN w.units > 0 THEN GREATEST(w.value - e.units * (w.value / w.units), 0)
              ELSE 0 END
    FROM walk w JOIN ev e ON e.hull = w.hull AND e.good = w.good AND e.rn = w.rn + 1),
inv AS (
  -- Inventory value per hull at each window boundary, from the walk above.
  SELECT b.asof, x.hull, SUM(x.value)::bigint AS value
    FROM (VALUES ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz), ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)) AS b(asof)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (w.hull, w.good) w.hull, w.value
        FROM walk w WHERE w.created_at < b.asof
       ORDER BY w.hull, w.good, w.rn DESC) x
   GROUP BY 1, 2),
w AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO'), 0) AS spent,
         COALESCE(SUM(t.amount)  FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'SELL_CARGO'), 0)     AS earned
    FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
   WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
       AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
       AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
   AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at))
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (w.earned - c.cogs) / NULLIF(c.cogs, 0), 1) AS "margin"
  FROM w CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(value) FROM inv WHERE asof = $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), 0)
         + w.spent
         - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(value) FROM inv WHERE asof = $__timeTo()::timestamptz), 0) AS cogs) c;

panels.title: Realised Net / Hour
panels.description: Trade net divided by the length of the selected window, so 30m / 2h / 24h are comparable. A rate over the window, not an instantaneous reading.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players)
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0)
       / NULLIF(EXTRACT(epoch FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)) / 3600.0, 0))::bigint
       AS "net per hour"
  FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
 WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
       AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
       AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
   AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at);

panels.title: Trade Hulls
panels.description: Ships whose dedicated_fleet is 'trade' right now. Live fleet state, not filtered by the time window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players)
SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS "trade hulls"
  FROM ships s CROSS JOIN me
 WHERE s.player_id = me.pid AND s.dedicated_fleet = 'trade';

panels.title: Capital in Cargo (at cost)
panels.description: Credits spent in this window on cargo not yet sold, valued at purchase price. The counterweight to a negative realised net: money deployed, not lost.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players),
open_cargo AS (
  -- Held cargo is per-(hull, good) NET units - bought minus sold - valued at that
  -- hull's average purchase cost for the good.  Deliberately NOT derived from a
  -- last-sell timestamp: hulls interleave lots, so a hull that sold an OLDER lot
  -- after buying a NEWER one had its entire held inventory erased (sp-d767k).
  -- units/good_symbol come from transactions.metadata, which carries both
  -- structurally on every cargo row - no description parsing.
  SELECT g.hull, COALESCE(SUM(g.net_units * g.avg_unit_cost), 0)::bigint AS open_cost
    FROM (
      SELECT t.metadata->>'ship_symbol' AS hull,
             t.metadata->>'good_symbol' AS good,
             COALESCE(SUM((t.metadata->>'units')::numeric)
                        FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO'), 0)
           - COALESCE(SUM((t.metadata->>'units')::numeric)
                        FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'SELL_CARGO'), 0)     AS net_units,
             COALESCE(SUM(-t.amount)
                        FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO'), 0)
           / NULLIF(SUM((t.metadata->>'units')::numeric)
                        FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO'), 0) AS avg_unit_cost
        FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
       WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
         AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
         AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
         AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'good_symbol','') <> ''
         AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
       GROUP BY 1, 2) g
   WHERE g.net_units > 0 AND g.avg_unit_cost IS NOT NULL
   GROUP BY 1)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oc.open_cost), 0) AS "in cargo"
  FROM open_cargo oc;

panels.title: Best Hull
panels.description: Highest realised net in the window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players),
tx AS (SELECT t.metadata->>'ship_symbol' AS hull, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS net
         FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
        WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
       AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
       AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> '' AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
        GROUP BY 1)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT hull || '   ' || to_char(net, 'FM999G999G999') || ' CR'
                   FROM tx ORDER BY net DESC LIMIT 1), 'no hull traded in window') AS "best hull";

panels.title: Worst Hull
panels.description: Lowest realised net in the window. A MID-RUN hull can appear here purely because it has bought and not yet sold -- check 'Net @ Cost' below before reading it as a loss.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players),
tx AS (SELECT t.metadata->>'ship_symbol' AS hull, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS net
         FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
        WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
       AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
       AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> '' AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
        GROUP BY 1)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT hull || '   ' || to_char(net, 'FM999G999G999') || ' CR'
                   FROM tx ORDER BY net ASC LIMIT 1), 'no hull traded in window') AS "worst hull";

panels.title: Contract Net (all ops)
panels.description: Net credits across every contract transaction in the window: advances plus payouts minus cargo and fuel. Kept separate from trade because CONTRACT_FULFILLED carries no ship_symbol and cannot be attributed to a hull.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS "contract net"
  FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
 WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'contract'
   AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at);

panels.title: Per-Hull P&L - realised, deployed, and honest net
panels.description: One row per hull in the trade fleet, plus any that traded in the window and has since been released; tour operations only. Net @ Cost = Realised Net + In Cargo, so a hull caught mid-run reads about zero, not a loss. Money columns honour the time picker; State, Hold and the nav columns read 'now'.

defaults.noValue: No trade-fleet hulls and no tour cargo transactions in this window

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players),
-- MOVING WEIGHTED-AVERAGE COST (sp-7kfof).  Walks every cargo event for each
-- (hull, good) in chronological order: a purchase adds its spend and units and so
-- re-averages the holding, a sale releases units at the THEN-CURRENT average.  The
-- value left standing at any instant is therefore what was actually paid for the
-- units still held.
--
-- IT REPLACES A LIFETIME AVERAGE, which is the defect this fixes.  The previous
-- valuation multiplied net units held by total spend / total units over ALL history
-- - two different populations.  The units held come from specific recent lots; the
-- average came from every lot ever bought.  On TORWIND-2F5 that valued 60 EQUIPMENT
-- bought at 1,983/u at 2,633.9/u and 105 URANITE bought at 3,394/u at 3,277.5/u; the
-- errors did not cancel, closing came out 641,517 against 602,850 actually paid, and
-- the 38,667 gap ate the COGS denominator until the row read 1212.7% on a 31.7% run.
--
-- sp-d767k IS HONOURED AND STRENGTHENED.  That rule says held cargo is per-(hull,
-- good) NET units - bought minus sold - and must NEVER be derived from a last-sell
-- timestamp, because hulls interleave lots and a hull that sold an OLDER lot after
-- buying a NEWER one had its whole inventory erased.  Walking every event in order
-- is strictly stronger than the net-units subtraction it replaces: it cannot be
-- fooled by interleaving because it never looks at an aggregate at all.
ev AS (
  SELECT t.metadata->>'ship_symbol' AS hull, t.metadata->>'good_symbol' AS good,
         t.created_at, (t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO') AS is_buy,
         (t.metadata->>'units')::numeric AS units, (-t.amount)::numeric AS spend,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.metadata->>'ship_symbol', t.metadata->>'good_symbol'
                            ORDER BY t.created_at, t.id) AS rn
    FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
   WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
     AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
     AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
     AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'good_symbol','') <> ''
     AND t.created_at <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
walk AS (
  SELECT hull, good, rn, created_at,
         CASE WHEN is_buy THEN units ELSE 0 END AS units,
         CASE WHEN is_buy THEN spend ELSE 0 END AS value
    FROM ev WHERE rn = 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.hull, e.good, e.rn, e.created_at,
         CASE WHEN e.is_buy THEN w.units + e.units ELSE GREATEST(w.units - e.units, 0) END,
         -- A sale releases units at the running average.  Clamped at zero so a sale
         -- of cargo this ledger never saw bought (or a partial history) can only ever
         -- empty the holding, never drive its value negative into the COGS below.
         CASE WHEN e.is_buy THEN w.value + e.spend
              WHEN w.units > 0 THEN GREATEST(w.value - e.units * (w.value / w.units), 0)
              ELSE 0 END
    FROM walk w JOIN ev e ON e.hull = w.hull AND e.good = w.good AND e.rn = w.rn + 1),
inv AS (
  -- Inventory value per hull at each window boundary, from the walk above.
  SELECT b.asof, x.hull, SUM(x.value)::bigint AS value
    FROM (VALUES ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz), ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)) AS b(asof)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (w.hull, w.good) w.hull, w.value
        FROM walk w WHERE w.created_at < b.asof
       ORDER BY w.hull, w.good, w.rn DESC) x
   GROUP BY 1, 2),
tx AS (
  SELECT t.metadata->>'ship_symbol' AS hull,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO')            AS buys,
         COALESCE(SUM(-t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO'), 0) AS spent,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'SELL_CARGO')                AS sells,
         COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'SELL_CARGO'), 0)      AS earned,
         COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0)                                               AS net
    FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
   WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
       AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
       AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
     AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
   GROUP BY 1),
cogs AS (
  -- opening inventory + purchases in window - closing inventory.  A hull flat at
  -- BOTH boundaries has opening = closing = 0, so this collapses to the window's own
  -- spend and the margin below reduces to (earned - spent)/spent exactly - the
  -- healthy case is preserved by construction, re-proved against the new valuation
  -- rule rather than inherited from sp-4gcts.
  SELECT tx.hull, COALESCE(io.value, 0) + COALESCE(tx.spent, 0) - COALESCE(ic.value, 0) AS cogs
    FROM tx
    LEFT JOIN inv io ON io.hull = tx.hull AND io.asof = $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    LEFT JOIN inv ic ON ic.hull = tx.hull AND ic.asof = $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
fleet AS (SELECT s.* FROM ships s CROSS JOIN me
           WHERE s.player_id = me.pid AND s.dedicated_fleet = 'trade')
SELECT COALESCE(f.ship_symbol, tx.hull)                              AS "Hull",
       CASE WHEN f.ship_symbol IS NULL              THEN 'RELEASED'
            WHEN COALESCE(tx.sells,0) > 0           THEN 'TRADING'
            WHEN COALESCE(f.cargo_units,0) > 0      THEN 'MID-RUN'
            WHEN COALESCE(tx.buys,0)  > 0           THEN 'MID-RUN'
            WHEN COALESCE(f.assignment_status,'') = 'active'
             AND COALESCE(f.container_id,'') LIKE 'tour-run-%'
                                                    THEN 'ON TOUR'
            ELSE 'IDLE' END                                          AS "State",
       COALESCE(tx.buys, 0)                                          AS "Buys",
       COALESCE(tx.sells, 0)                                         AS "Sells",
       COALESCE(tx.spent, 0)                                         AS "Spent",
       COALESCE(tx.earned, 0)                                        AS "Earned",
       COALESCE(tx.net, 0)                                           AS "Realised Net",
       -- Cargo held at the window's END, valued by the SAME walk the COGS uses
       -- (sp-7kfof).  It used to be a separate window-clipped average that could
       -- disagree with the closing inventory on the very same row - 602,850 against
       -- 641,517 on TORWIND-2F5 - which is indefensible for two readings of one
       -- quantity, so they are now one number by construction.
       COALESCE(ic.value, 0)                                         AS "In Cargo",
       COALESCE(tx.net, 0) + COALESCE(ic.value, 0)                   AS "Net @ Cost",
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(tx.sells,0) > 0 AND COALESCE(cg.cogs,0) > 0
            THEN ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(tx.earned,0) - cg.cogs) / cg.cogs, 1)
            END                                                      AS "Margin %",
       COALESCE(f.cargo_units, 0)                                    AS "Hold",
       COALESCE(f.cargo_capacity, 0)                                 AS "Cap",
       COALESCE(f.system_symbol, '-')                                AS "System",
       COALESCE(f.nav_status, '-')                                   AS "Nav",
       COALESCE(substring(f.container_id from '[0-9a-f]{8}$'), '-') AS "Tour"
  FROM tx
  FULL OUTER JOIN fleet f ON f.ship_symbol = tx.hull
  LEFT JOIN cogs cg ON cg.hull = COALESCE(f.ship_symbol, tx.hull)
  LEFT JOIN inv  ic ON ic.hull = COALESCE(f.ship_symbol, tx.hull) AND ic.asof = $__timeTo()::timestamptz
 ORDER BY COALESCE(tx.net, 0) DESC;

panels.title: Realised Net by Hull
panels.description: Realised tour net per hull over the window, worst to best. Bars below zero are hulls that have bought and not yet sold -- compare with 'Net @ Cost' above.

defaults.noValue: No hull traded on a tour in this window

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players)
SELECT t.metadata->>'ship_symbol' AS "Hull", COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS "Realised Net"
  FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
 WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
       AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
       AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
   AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC;

panels.title: Cumulative Net by Hull
panels.description: Running realised net per hull across the window. A flat line is a hull in transit or loading; a step up is a sale landing.

defaults.noValue: No hull traded on a tour in this window

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players),
b AS (SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t.created_at, $__interval),
             t.metadata->>'ship_symbol' AS metric,
             COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS v
        FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
       WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
       AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
       AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
         AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
       GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT time, metric, SUM(v) OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY time) AS value
  FROM b ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.title: Revenue vs Spend vs Net
panels.description: Tour cargo flow bucketed by the dashboard interval. Spend is plotted positive so the two gross flows are directly comparable; Net is the signed difference.

defaults.noValue: No tour cargo transactions in this window

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t.created_at, $__interval),
       COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'SELL_CARGO'), 0)      AS "Revenue",
       COALESCE(SUM(-t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO'), 0) AS "Spend",
       COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0)                                                       AS "Net"
  FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
 WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
       AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
       AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
   AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Cumulative Trade Net vs Treasury
panels.description: Cumulative realised trade net in the window against the actual credit balance. The gap is everything trading does not control -- ship purchases above all: if trade net climbs while treasury falls, capex is outspending trading.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players),
spine AS (
  SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t.created_at, $__interval),
         COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (
             WHERE t.operation_type = 'tour'
               AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
               AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''), 0) AS trade_v,
         (array_agg(t.balance_after ORDER BY t.created_at DESC))[1]   AS treasury
    FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
   WHERE t.player_id = me.pid
     AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
   GROUP BY 1)
SELECT time,
       SUM(trade_v) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS "Cumulative Trade Net",
       treasury                          AS "Treasury"
  FROM spine ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Hull payback  (LIFETIME - this whole section ignores the time picker)
Trade-Hull Capex (actual)
panels.description: Every credit spent on PURCHASE_SHIP for a trade-capable hull type this era. Lifetime, not windowed. An exact ledger sum, so it counts hulls since lost or released and exceeds the table's Capex column.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-t.amount), 0) AS "trade-hull capex"
  FROM transactions t
 WHERE t.player_id = $player AND t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_SHIP'
   AND t.metadata->>'ship_type' IN ('SHIP_HEAVY_FREIGHTER','SHIP_LIGHT_HAULER');

panels.title: Trade Net (lifetime, all hulls)
panels.description: Realised tour cargo net -- sells minus buys -- for every hull this era, including hulls that have since left the fleet. Lifetime, not windowed. Cargo still in a hold is not credited, so this is a conservative floor.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS "lifetime trade net"
  FROM transactions t
 WHERE t.player_id = $player AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
   AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
   AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> '';

panels.title: Fleet Payback %
panels.description: Lifetime realised tour net over lifetime trade-hull capex: 100% means trading has earned back every credit ever spent on trade hulls. Lifetime, not windowed. Open cargo is excluded, so it reads slightly low.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cap AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-t.amount), 0) AS v
    FROM transactions t
   WHERE t.player_id = $player AND t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_SHIP'
     AND t.metadata->>'ship_type' IN ('SHIP_HEAVY_FREIGHTER','SHIP_LIGHT_HAULER')),
net AS (

targets.rawSql:
WITH hull_capex AS (

  -- purchase stamps the hull it produced on related_entity_type/id (indexed) and
  -- the server's purchase instant in metadata.  DISTINCT ON keeps one receipt per

         t.related_entity_id                                               AS hull,
         (-t.amount)::bigint                                               AS price,
         COALESCE((t.metadata->>'purchased_at')::timestamptz, t.created_at) AS purchased_at
    FROM transactions t
   WHERE t.player_id = $player AND t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_SHIP'
     AND t.related_entity_type = 'ship' AND COALESCE(t.related_entity_id, '') <> ''
   ORDER BY t.related_entity_id, t.created_at DESC),

  -- change, whose rows recorded the ship type where the hull belonged and can
  -- never be attributed.  Deliberately retained, not superseded.

           WHEN 'SHIP_LIGHT_HAULER'    THEN 'FRAME_LIGHT_FREIGHTER'

           WHEN 'SHIP_EXPLORER'        THEN 'FRAME_EXPLORER'
           WHEN 'SHIP_COMMAND_FRIGATE' THEN 'FRAME_FRIGATE'
         END                                                          AS frame,

    FROM transactions t
   WHERE t.player_id = $player AND t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_SHIP'
   GROUP BY 1),

  SELECT t.metadata->>'ship_symbol'                                       AS hull,
         MIN(t.created_at)                                                AS first_trade,
         COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0)                                       AS net,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'SELL_CARGO')        AS sells
    FROM transactions t
   WHERE t.player_id = $player AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
     AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
     AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''

  -- structurally on every cargo row - no description parsing.

    FROM (

         AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'good_symbol','') <> ''

   WHERE s.player_id = $player AND s.dedicated_fleet = 'trade'),

         SUM(t.amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.metadata->>'ship_symbol'

    FROM transactions t
   WHERE t.player_id = $player AND t.operation_type = 'tour'

     AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''),

    FROM running r JOIN base b ON b.hull = r.hull
   WHERE b.capex IS NOT NULL AND r.cum >= b.capex
   GROUP BY 1),

  SELECT b.*, p.paid_at,
         (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.paid_at - b.age_from)) / 3600.0)::numeric AS paid_h,
         b.at_cost / NULLIF(b.tenure_h, 0)                                AS rate
    FROM base b LEFT JOIN paid p ON p.hull = b.hull)

       replace(h.frame_symbol, 'FRAME_', '')             AS "Frame",
       ROUND(h.tenure_h, 2)                              AS "Tenure",
       COALESCE(h.age_basis, '-')                        AS "Tenure from",
       h.capex                                           AS "Capex",
       COALESCE(h.capex_basis, '-')                      AS "Capex basis",
       h.realised                                        AS "Realised Net",
       h.in_cargo                                        AS "In Cargo",
       h.at_cost                                         AS "Net @ Cost",
       ROUND(h.rate)                                     AS "Net @ Cost / h",
       CASE WHEN h.capex > 0
            THEN ROUND(100.0 * h.at_cost / h.capex, 1) END AS "Payback %",
       ROUND(h.paid_h, 2)                                AS "Paid back in",
       CASE WHEN h.paid_at IS NULL AND h.capex IS NOT NULL AND h.rate > 0
            THEN ROUND((h.capex - h.at_cost) / h.rate, 2) END AS "ETA",
       CASE WHEN h.paid_at IS NOT NULL THEN 0
            ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(h.capex, 0) - h.at_cost, 0) END AS "Remaining CR",
       CASE WHEN h.capex IS NULL              THEN 'NO CAPEX'
            WHEN h.paid_at IS NOT NULL         THEN 'PAID'
            WHEN h.at_cost >= h.capex          THEN 'PAID @ COST'
            WHEN h.first_trade IS NULL         THEN 'NO TRADES'
            WHEN h.sells = 0                   THEN 'NO SALES YET'
            WHEN h.rate > 0                    THEN 'EARNING'
            ELSE 'STALLED' END                            AS "Status"
  FROM h
 ORDER BY CASE WHEN h.paid_at IS NOT NULL THEN 0
               ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(h.capex, 0) - h.at_cost, 0) END DESC,

panels.title: Fleet Cumulative Trade Net vs Trade-Hull Capex
panels.description: Green is cumulative realised tour net across every hull; amber is cumulative PURCHASE_SHIP outlay on trade hulls. Where green crosses above amber the fleet has paid for itself. Both sums cover the whole era -- the fixed 7-day axis clips the view, never the maths.

defaults.noValue: No transactions in the current era

targets.rawSql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT t.created_at,
         CASE WHEN t.operation_type = 'tour'
               AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
               AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
              THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END AS trade_v,
         CASE WHEN t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_SHIP'
               AND t.metadata->>'ship_type' IN ('SHIP_HEAVY_FREIGHTER','SHIP_LIGHT_HAULER')
              THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END AS capex_v
    FROM transactions t
   WHERE t.player_id = $player),
b AS (
  SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval),
         COALESCE(SUM(trade_v), 0) AS trade_v,
         COALESCE(SUM(capex_v), 0) AS capex_v
    FROM ev
   GROUP BY 1),
c AS (
  SELECT time,
         SUM(trade_v) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS net,
         SUM(capex_v) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS capex
    FROM b)
-- Deliberately unfiltered by time.  Both series must carry their true cumulative
-- level at the left edge of whatever window is shown, so the running sums span the
-- whole era and the panel axis does the clipping.  A time macro on the grouped
-- column would not work here anyway: it is an epoch number, not a timestamptz.
SELECT time,
       net   AS "Cumulative Trade Net",
       capex AS "Cumulative Trade-Hull Capex"
  FROM c
 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Profitability by Good
panels.description: Tour cargo grouped by good. Net is meaningful here because a good is bought and sold as the same commodity -- but still window-clipped: a good sold from cargo bought before the window shows revenue with no matching spend.

defaults.noValue: No tour cargo transactions in this window

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players),
-- MOVING WEIGHTED-AVERAGE COST (sp-7kfof).  Walks every cargo event for each
-- (hull, good) in chronological order: a purchase adds its spend and units and so
-- re-averages the holding, a sale releases units at the THEN-CURRENT average.  The
-- value left standing at any instant is therefore what was actually paid for the
-- units still held.
--
-- IT REPLACES A LIFETIME AVERAGE, which is the defect this fixes.  The previous
-- valuation multiplied net units held by total spend / total units over ALL history
-- - two different populations.  The units held come from specific recent lots; the
-- average came from every lot ever bought.  On TORWIND-2F5 that valued 60 EQUIPMENT
-- bought at 1,983/u at 2,633.9/u and 105 URANITE bought at 3,394/u at 3,277.5/u; the
-- errors did not cancel, closing came out 641,517 against 602,850 actually paid, and
-- the 38,667 gap ate the COGS denominator until the row read 1212.7% on a 31.7% run.
--
-- sp-d767k IS HONOURED AND STRENGTHENED.  That rule says held cargo is per-(hull,
-- good) NET units - bought minus sold - and must NEVER be derived from a last-sell
-- timestamp, because hulls interleave lots and a hull that sold an OLDER lot after
-- buying a NEWER one had its whole inventory erased.  Walking every event in order
-- is strictly stronger than the net-units subtraction it replaces: it cannot be
-- fooled by interleaving because it never looks at an aggregate at all.
ev AS (
  SELECT t.metadata->>'ship_symbol' AS hull, t.metadata->>'good_symbol' AS good,
         t.created_at, (t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO') AS is_buy,
         (t.metadata->>'units')::numeric AS units, (-t.amount)::numeric AS spend,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.metadata->>'ship_symbol', t.metadata->>'good_symbol'
                            ORDER BY t.created_at, t.id) AS rn
    FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
   WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
     AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
     AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
     AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'good_symbol','') <> ''
     AND t.created_at <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
walk AS (
  SELECT hull, good, rn, created_at,
         CASE WHEN is_buy THEN units ELSE 0 END AS units,
         CASE WHEN is_buy THEN spend ELSE 0 END AS value
    FROM ev WHERE rn = 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.hull, e.good, e.rn, e.created_at,
         CASE WHEN e.is_buy THEN w.units + e.units ELSE GREATEST(w.units - e.units, 0) END,
         -- A sale releases units at the running average.  Clamped at zero so a sale
         -- of cargo this ledger never saw bought (or a partial history) can only ever
         -- empty the holding, never drive its value negative into the COGS below.
         CASE WHEN e.is_buy THEN w.value + e.spend
              WHEN w.units > 0 THEN GREATEST(w.value - e.units * (w.value / w.units), 0)
              ELSE 0 END
    FROM walk w JOIN ev e ON e.hull = w.hull AND e.good = w.good AND e.rn = w.rn + 1),

inv AS (
  -- Same walk, aggregated by GOOD rather than by hull.
  SELECT b.asof, x.good, SUM(x.value)::bigint AS value
    FROM (VALUES ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz), ($__timeTo()::timestamptz)) AS b(asof)
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (w.hull, w.good) w.good, w.value
        FROM walk w WHERE w.created_at < b.asof
       ORDER BY w.hull, w.good, w.rn DESC) x
   GROUP BY 1, 2),
g AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(t.metadata->>'good_symbol',''), '(unknown)')                     AS good,
         COALESCE(SUM(-t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO'), 0) AS spent,
         COALESCE(SUM(t.amount)  FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'SELL_CARGO'), 0)     AS earned,
         COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0)                                                       AS net,
         COALESCE(SUM((t.metadata->>'units')::bigint)
                  FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'SELL_CARGO'), 0)                    AS units_sold
    FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
   WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
       AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
       AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
   AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
   GROUP BY 1)
SELECT g.good        AS "Good",
       g.spent       AS "Spent",
       g.earned      AS "Earned",
       g.net         AS "Net",
       g.units_sold  AS "Units Sold",
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(io.value,0) + g.spent - COALESCE(ic.value,0) > 0
            THEN ROUND(100.0 * (g.earned - (COALESCE(io.value,0) + g.spent - COALESCE(ic.value,0)))
                       / (COALESCE(io.value,0) + g.spent - COALESCE(ic.value,0)), 1) END AS "Margin %"
  FROM g
  LEFT JOIN inv io ON io.good = g.good AND io.asof = $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
  LEFT JOIN inv ic ON ic.good = g.good AND ic.asof = $__timeTo()::timestamptz
 ORDER BY 4 DESC;

panels.title: Buy-side vs Sell-side by System
panels.description: Where cargo is sourced and where it is vended, by the system owning each transaction waypoint. Deliberately no net column: goods are bought in one system and sold in another, so a per-system net would be an artefact of the route. Flow is sell-side minus buy-side volume.

defaults.noValue: No tour cargo transactions in this window

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players)
SELECT COALESCE(w.system_symbol, '(unmapped waypoint)')                                 AS "System",
       COALESCE(SUM(-t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO'), 0) AS "Bought Here",
       COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'SELL_CARGO'), 0)      AS "Sold Here",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO')                    AS "Buys",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'SELL_CARGO')                        AS "Sells",
       COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'SELL_CARGO'), 0)
       - COALESCE(SUM(-t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO'), 0) AS "Flow"
  FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
  LEFT JOIN waypoints w ON w.waypoint_symbol = t.metadata->>'waypoint'
 WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'tour'
       AND t.transaction_type IN ('PURCHASE_CARGO','SELL_CARGO')
       AND COALESCE(t.metadata->>'ship_symbol','') <> ''
   AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC;

panels.title: Realised Capital by Operation
panels.description: Every transaction in the window grouped by operation_type -- the honest answer to 'why did treasury move'. Trading can be strongly positive while the balance falls, because ship purchases are capex booked in the same ledger.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players)
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(t.operation_type,''), '(unattributed)')      AS "Operation",
       COUNT(*)                                                     AS "Txns",
       COALESCE(SUM(-t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.amount < 0), 0)      AS "Outflow",
       COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.amount > 0), 0)       AS "Inflow",
       COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0)                                   AS "Net"
  FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
 WHERE t.player_id = me.pid
   AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 5 DESC;

panels.title: Cumulative Net by Operation
panels.description: Running net per operation_type. The downward line is almost always 'fleet expansion': capex, not a trading loss.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players),
b AS (SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t.created_at, $__interval),
             COALESCE(NULLIF(t.operation_type,''), '(unattributed)') AS metric,
             COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS v
        FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
       WHERE t.player_id = me.pid
         AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
       GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT time, metric, SUM(v) OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY time) AS value
  FROM b ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.title: Contract Economics (fleet level - not attributable per hull)
panels.description: Contract money in full. CONTRACT_ACCEPTED is the advance, CONTRACT_FULFILLED the payout, and neither carries a ship_symbol, so contract revenue can never be split per hull. That is why the P&L table above is scoped to tours.

defaults.noValue: No contract activity in this window

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'CONTRACT_ACCEPTED'), 0)  AS "Advances",
       COALESCE(SUM(t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'CONTRACT_FULFILLED'), 0) AS "Payouts",
       COALESCE(SUM(-t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_CARGO'), 0)    AS "Cargo Cost",
       COALESCE(SUM(-t.amount) FILTER (WHERE t.transaction_type = 'REFUEL'), 0)            AS "Fuel",
       COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0)                                                          AS "Net"
  FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
 WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.operation_type = 'contract'
   AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at);

panels.title: Fuel by Operation (fleet level only)
panels.description: Refuelling spend per operation. REFUEL rows store ship_symbol as an empty string, so fuel cannot be attributed to a hull -- it is deliberately absent from the per-hull table rather than guessed at.

targets.rawSql:
WITH me AS (SELECT MAX(id) AS pid FROM players)
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(t.operation_type,''), '(unattributed)') AS "Operation",
       COUNT(*)                                                AS "Refuels",
       COALESCE(SUM(-t.amount), 0)                             AS "Fuel Spend",
       COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(-t.amount)), 0)::bigint              AS "Avg per Refuel"
  FROM transactions t CROSS JOIN me
 WHERE t.player_id = me.pid AND t.transaction_type = 'REFUEL'
   AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at)
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC;

panels.title: What this dashboard cannot show you (attribution limits)

options.content:
Structural limits of the `transactions` ledger. Nothing here infers around them: a fabricated number is worse than an absent one.

- **Contract revenue has no hull.** `CONTRACT_ACCEPTED` / `CONTRACT_FULFILLED` carry only `contract_id` and `faction`; their cargo purchases *do* carry one. A net spanning both would show every contract hull deeply negative, so the per-hull table is scoped to tours and contract money is reported whole in *Contract Economics*.
- **Fuel has no hull.** `REFUEL` stores `ship_symbol` as an empty string, not null, so an `IS NOT NULL` guard admits it and invents a phantom blank hull. Every query filters `<> ''`. Fuel is per operation only; per-hull net is *before* fuel.
- **Held cargo has no cost basis.** `ships.cargo_inventory` records units, not price. *In Cargo* is reconstructed from purchases after a hull's last sale, valued at cost -- a floor, not a mark-to-market.
- **Historical hull purchases have no hull.** Rows written before the ledger fix stamped the ship *type* and left `related_entity_id` empty, and `ships` keeps no purchase price or date to recover from -- unattributable forever. Purchases now stamp the hull, the entity link and the server's purchase instant.
- **The window clips open positions at both ends.** A sale settling inside the window from cargo bought outside it shows revenue with no matching spend; the mirror case deflates. Widen the range until the figures stop moving.

**Reading *Hull payback*.** All of it is lifetime and ignores the time picker: a cumulative quantity clipped to a short window shows an old hull earning only its last few hours and looking permanently unpaid.

- *Capex basis*: `exact` is the hull's own receipt. `frame avg` charges the mean price for its frame -- individual purchases run -10% to +14% around it this era, under an hour of payback -- so read that row as a class figure, not per-hull precision.
- *Tenure from*: `purchase` is the hull's true age. `first trade` understates it by the purchase-to-first-trade gap (2 to 75 minutes this era), so that row reads optimistic by about as much.
- *Median* and *p90 Payback Time* are right-censored on purpose: only hulls that have paid back are in them. *Median Age, Unpaid Hulls* is what decides whether the rest are merely young or genuinely slow.
- *Status*: PAID = realised net crossed capex. PAID @ COST = the position covers capex but has not been banked. NO TRADES / NO SALES YET = nothing to project from. EARNING = working towards it. STALLED = rate no longer positive. NO CAPEX = neither basis can attribute anything. A hull can read PAID while *Payback %* has dipped under 100 -- it crossed, then bought another load. *ETA* is blank when the rate is zero or negative: cannot be projected, not zero.
- Hulls that traded this era and have since left the fleet are absent from the per-hull payback panels -- no frame, so no capex -- but their earnings are in *Trade Net (lifetime)* and *Fleet Payback %*.
- *Per-Hull P&L* **State**: TRADING sold in the window; MID-RUN holds cargo it has paid for; ON TOUR is claimed on a live tour before its first buy leg (working, not idle); IDLE has no tour, cargo or trades; RELEASED has left the trade fleet.

*Per-tour planned-vs-actual profit is not modelled: the planner's expected margin is not persisted beside the realised transactions. `SpaceTraders - Heavy Trading` carries tour-lifecycle and guard diagnostics; this dashboard is the P&L view.*
